#Subgroup Analysis

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(readr)
library(base)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(xtable)
library(stargazer)
library(plm)
library(sjPlot)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(ggpubr)
library(broom)
library(forcats)  # For reordering the terms
```

#Data Loading and Recoding
```{r}
ess_ches = read.csv(here::here("data", "ess_ches.csv"))

ess_ches$Christian = ifelse(ess_ches$religion == 1, 1, 0)
ess_ches$Muslim = ifelse(ess_ches$religion == 2, 1, 0)

ess_ches$imatt = NA
ess_ches$imatt = 1/3*(ess_ches$imbgeco + ess_ches$imueclt + ess_ches$imwbcnt)

ess_ches$immpol = NA
ess_ches$immpol = 1/3*(ess_ches$impol1 + ess_ches$impol2 + ess_ches$impol3)

subgroup = subset(ess_ches, status == "first")
native = subset(ess_ches, status == "native")
subgroup = subset(subgroup, livecnta != 9999)
native = subset(native, livecnta != 9999)
native = native[!is.na(native$livecnta), ]

subgroup = subgroup[!is.na(subgroup$livecnta), ]
```

```{r}
subgroup$arrive = ifelse(subgroup$essround == 9,
                         subgroup$age - (2018- subgroup$livecnta),
                         ifelse(subgroup$essround == 10,
                                subgroup$age - (2020 - subgroup$livecnta), NA))

subgroup = subset(subgroup, arrive >= 0)

subgroup$anti_imm = NA
subgroup$anti_imm = ifelse(is.na(subgroup$immigrate_policy), NA,
                    ifelse(subgroup$immigrate_policy >= 7, 1, 0))

native$anti_imm = NA
native$anti_imm = ifelse(is.na(native$immigrate_policy), NA,
                    ifelse(native$immigrate_policy >= 7, 1, 0))
```

#cut off as 6,10,14, 18
```{r}
young6 = subset(subgroup, arrive<= 6)
old6 = subset(subgroup, arrive> 6)

young10 = subset(subgroup, arrive<= 10)
old10 = subset(subgroup, arrive> 10)

young14 = subset(subgroup, arrive<= 14)
old14 = subset(subgroup, arrive> 14)

young18 = subset(subgroup, arrive<= 18)
old18 = subset(subgroup, arrive> 18)
```

We decided to use cutoff at 10 for our main subgroup analysis. But we also include other cutoffs in the appendix as robustness check. 

# Figure A3
```{r}
young1 <- lm(immigrate_policy ~ lrscale + age + gender + Christian + Muslim + education, data = young10)

old1 <- lm(immigrate_policy ~ lrscale + age + gender + Christian + Muslim + education, data = old10)

native1 <- lm(immigrate_policy ~ lrscale + age + gender + Christian + Muslim + education, data = native)

young_tidy <- tidy(young1) %>% 
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>% 
    mutate(Group = "Young Arrival")

old_tidy <- tidy(old1) %>% 
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>% 
    mutate(Group = "Late Arrival")

native_tidy <- tidy(native1) %>% 
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>% 
    mutate(Group = "Native")

young_ci <- confint(young1) %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>%
    filter(row.names(.) != "(Intercept)") %>% 
    rename(Lower_CI = `2.5 %`, Upper_CI = `97.5 %`)

old_ci <- confint(old1) %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>%
    filter(row.names(.) != "(Intercept)") %>% 
    rename(Lower_CI = `2.5 %`, Upper_CI = `97.5 %`)

native_ci <- confint(native1) %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>%
    filter(row.names(.) != "(Intercept)") %>% 
    rename(Lower_CI = `2.5 %`, Upper_CI = `97.5 %`)

young_data <- cbind(young_tidy, young_ci)
old_data <- cbind(old_tidy, old_ci)
native_data = cbind(native_tidy, native_ci)

data <- bind_rows(young_data, old_data, native_data)

data <- data %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Native", "Young Arrival", "Late Arrival" ))) %>%
    mutate(term = recode(term, "lrscale" = "Political Ideology",
                         "age" = "Age",
                         "gender" = "Gender",
                         "Christian" = "Christian",
                         "Muslim" = "Muslim",
                         "education" = "Education"))

ggplot(data, aes(x = estimate, y = term, shape = Group)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Lower_CI, xmax = Upper_CI), height = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
    labs(title ="Ideology and Party Choice (Age 10 Cutoff)", 
         x = "Coefficient Estimates",
         y = "") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Young Arrival" = 16, "Late Arrival" = 17,
                                  "Native" = 18))
ggsave(here::here("Figures", "Figure A3_Ideology.png"), width=9,height=4)

```

#Figure 5
Young arrivals with negative attitudes are more likely to support restrictive policies, reflecting stronger alignment iwth anti-immigration positions. 
```{r}

old1 <- lm(immigrate_policy ~ immpol + age + gender + Christian + Muslim + education, data = old10)
native1 <- lm(immigrate_policy ~ immpol + age + gender + Christian + Muslim + education, data = native)

    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%

    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>% 
    mutate(Group = "Late Arrival")

native_tidy <- tidy(native1) %>% 
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>% 
    mutate(Group = "Native")

    as.data.frame() %>%
    filter(row.names(.) != "(Intercept)") %>%

old_ci <- confint(old1) %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>%
    filter(row.names(.) != "(Intercept)") %>% 
    rename(Lower_CI = `2.5 %`, Upper_CI = `97.5 %`)
```

# Figure 7
```{r}
ess_sub = ess_ches %>% filter(status=="first") 
ess_sub$livecnta[ess_sub$livecnta>2020] <-NA
ess_sub$arrive = ifelse(ess_sub$essround == 9,
                         ess_sub$age - (2018- ess_sub$livecnta),
                         ifelse(ess_sub$essround == 10,
                                ess_sub$age - (2020 - ess_sub$livecnta), NA))

ess_sub$arrive[ess_sub$arrive==-7] <- NA

ess_sub$arrive_group <-  cut(ess_sub$arrive, breaks=seq(0,75,5), labels=seq(0,70,5))
ess_sub$arrive_group <- as.numeric(as.character(ess_sub$arrive_group))

cohortfit1 = lm(immigrate_policy~immpol*(arrive_group) + gender+Christian + Muslim +education + country + factor(essround), data=ess_sub)

cohortfit2 = lm(immigrate_policy~imatt*(arrive_group) + gender+Christian + Muslim +education + country + factor(essround), data=ess_sub)

#Figure 7a
interplot::interplot(cohortfit1, var2="arrive_group",var1="immpol",point = T,
                    ercolor="gray30", color="gray30",size=2, esize=1) +
  theme_bw() + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype="dashed", color="gray60") +
#  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust=1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0,70,5),labels=seq(0,70,5))+
  labs(x="Age at migration", y="Coefficients") +
  theme(text=element_text(size=14))
ggsave(here::here("Figures", "Figure 7a_immpol.png"),width=7,height=5) 

#Figure 7b
interplot::interplot(cohortfit2, var2="arrive_group",var1="imatt",point = T,
                    ercolor="gray30", color="gray30",size=2, esize=1)+
  theme_bw() + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype="dashed", color="gray60") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0,70,5),labels=seq(0,70,5))+
  labs(x="Age at migration", y="Coefficients")+
  theme(text=element_text(size=14))
ggsave(here::here("Figures", "Figure 7b_imatt.png"),width=7,height=5) 
```

#cutoff at 6
```{r}
young6_1= lm(immigrate_policy~lrscale, data=young6)
young6_2 = lm(immigrate_policy~lrscale + age+gender+Christian + Muslim +education, data=young6)
young6_3 = plm(immigrate_policy~lrscale + age+gender+Christian + Muslim +education, data=young6, 
              model="within", index=c("country","essround"))
young6_4 = lm(immigrate_policy~lrscale + age+gender+Christian + Muslim +education + country + factor(essround),
             data=young6)
#stargazer::stargazer(young6_1, young6_2, young6_3, young6_4, type="latex",df=F, omit=c("country","essround"))

old6_1= lm(immigrate_policy~lrscale, data=old6)
old6_2 = lm(immigrate_policy~lrscale + age+gender+Christian + Muslim +education, data=old6)
old6_3 = plm(immigrate_policy~lrscale + age+gender+Christian + Muslim +education, data=old6, 
              model="within", index=c("country","essround"))
old6_4 = lm(immigrate_policy~lrscale + age+gender+Christian + Muslim +education + country + factor(essround),
             data=old6)
#stargazer::stargazer(old6_1, old6_2, old6_3, old6_4, type="text",df=F, omit=c("country","essround"))
```

#additive index: attitudes towards immigration policy: age 6
```{r}

h3fit1 = lm(immigrate_policy~immpol, data=young6)
h3fit2 = lm(immigrate_policy~immpol + age+gender+Christian + Muslim +education, data=young6)
h3fit3 = plm(immigrate_policy~immpol + age+gender+Christian + Muslim +education, data=young6, 
              model="within", index=c("country","essround"))
h3fit4 = lm(immigrate_policy~immpol + age+gender+
               Christian + Muslim +education + country + factor(essround),
             data=young6)
#stargazer::stargazer(h3fit1, h3fit2, h3fit3,h3fit4, type="text",df=F, omit=c("country","essround"))
```
